Palestinians Seek Protection During Olive Harvest Amid Settler Violence

Palestinians are seeking protection from violent settlers during the annual olive harvest in the West Bank. An initiative called the Global Sumud Flotilla is recruiting activists to provide aid and support to Palestinians during this period. The olive harvest is a significant time for the Palestinian community, and reports indicate concerns over settler aggression impacting the process.
